doc.headline: Run Brisk-S with low reasoning and one retry: it clears the {criteria.pass_rate.threshold} pass-rate gate at {cost_per_1k.brisk-s.low.r1} per 1k calls, but only by {criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.gap} points.
doc.lede: Five of 18 configurations clear the gate, and this one costs least and dominates the other four. Its clearance is a point estimate that a fresh run reads the wrong way {settle.criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.overall.wrong_side} of the time.

caveats.material_if: the true pass rate of the pick sits below the gate; its clearance is {criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.gap} points with no interval, so a re-run reads the wrong way {settle.criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.overall.wrong_side} of the time
the pick's lead over the next survivor is smaller than chance; it was chosen from {n_candidates} configurations, so a re-run on fresh cases tends to read it lower
a claim needs one arm shown better than another; none is read paired, so arms compare only on their own figures

decision.text: Run Brisk-S, reasoning low, one retry ({measure.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.mean} pass rate, {cost_per_1k.brisk-s.low.r1} per 1k calls, {cost_per_month.brisk-s.low.r1} a month at declared volume). It is the only survivor no other survivor dominates.

Thirteen configurations miss the gate; every Nano-XS one is far below it, for example {criteria.pass_rate.nano-xs.low.r1.value} at best with low reasoning. Atlas-M with high reasoning and a retry passes at {measure.pass_rate.atlas-m.high.r1.mean} but costs {cost_per_1k.atlas-m.high.r1} per 1k.

The pick clears the gate by {criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.gap} points, the thinnest clearance of any survivor, read on the point estimate. Settling it needs {settle.criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.overall.cases_needed_two_sided_80} cases at four-in-five odds. Multi-hop is its weakest task at {task.multihop.brisk-s.low.r1.pass_rate.mean}. The safer step up is Brisk-S with high reasoning ({measure.pass_rate.brisk-s.high.r1.mean}) for {price.brisk-s.low.r1.brisk-s.high.r1.pass_rate.monthly_cost_gap} more a month.
Re-run the pick and Brisk-S high with a retry on fresh cases; if the pick reads below the gate, move up to the high setting.

claims.text: Brisk-S with low reasoning and a retry costs least among the five configurations that pass, and none of the other four matches it on both cost and pass rate.

evidence.caption: Cost against pass rate; the frontier runs from the pick to Brisk-S high to Atlas-M high with a retry.

claims.text: The clearance is thin: the pick passes at {measure.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.mean} against a {criteria.pass_rate.threshold} gate, and the gate is read on point estimates only.

evidence.caption: Pass rate for all 18 configurations against the gate.

explore.binds: Which configuration is cheapest that passes
explore.outcome: Raised above {criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.value}, the pick falls out and Brisk-S high with a retry ({measure.pass_rate.brisk-s.high.r1.mean}) takes over; above that, Atlas-M high with a retry; above {measure.pass_rate.atlas-m.high.r1.mean} nothing passes.

omitted.what: Latency, calls per task and extra calls
omitted.why: No bar was declared on them; they do not change the call.

omitted.what: Per-model reasoning and retry lever effects
omitted.why: Descriptive, unpaired, and the pick already summarises them.

next.text: Re-run the pick and Brisk-S high with a retry on fresh cases, sized at the four-in-five figure.
next.settles: Whether the pick truly clears the gate or Brisk-S high is needed.

next.text: Declare a price for a point of pass rate.
next.settles: Whether the extra {price.brisk-s.low.r1.brisk-s.high.r1.pass_rate.monthly_cost_gap} a month for the higher setting is worth it.

method.text: The share of cases a configuration answers correctly; the campaign does not say what counts as correct.
Cost per 1k calls as measured; no provider is named for any configuration, so the routing behind it is unknown. The monthly volume of {meta.volume_per_month} does not say what it counts.
18 configurations of model, reasoning and retry, with no control; nothing is paired, and the gate has no interval.

content.text: Drop the reference for the scatter; fix the typed 18s.
